name: Camera Panel
description: Browse cameras and snapshots from connected camera resources. Choose a camera name and image refresh timing.

displayName.title: Name in admin
displayName.description: Name this copy for its purpose, such as Lobby weather or Workshop energy. Its connection ID stays the same.

title.title: Display title
title.description: Default heading on the display. A screen panel can override it.

cameraName.title: Preferred camera name
cameraName.description: Camera name supplied by the connected camera service. Empty uses the default camera.

frameRefreshMs.title: Image refresh · milliseconds
frameRefreshMs.description: Time between snapshot updates, in milliseconds.

preferredId.title: Preferred camera ID
preferredId.description: Leave empty to use the first camera returned by the service.

clearcamCameraName.title: Snapshot camera name
clearcamCameraName.description: Name used by the snapshot service. Leave empty to use the panel camera name.

enableAISnapshots.title: Use detection snapshots
enableAISnapshots.description: Use fresh snapshots from the detection service, with the camera stream as fallback.
